AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

3. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

4. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.

8. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

10. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.

11. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

12. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
